summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Baozun Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results via a press release. The filing contains routine quarterly earnings disclosure, including revenue, operating income, and non-GAAP metrics. It does not announce or relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. The CEO and CFO comments focus on operational performance and profitability, with no mention of extraordinary corporate events.
